source_prompt.selection: Exact paragraph/bullet references; no instruction text is rewritten.

experience_source.mapping_method: Human-readable reviewed phase-operation association, not chronological or causal inference; based only on TRAIN annotations.

stages.goal: Measure cup/vase rims and choose a current grasp and arm that support the complete pouring rotation.
stages.applicability: The filled cup is supported; the receiving inner opening and planned pouring clearance need binding.
completion: Current rim geometry is supported or unknown is retained.
The grasp choice is checked against the intended full pour attitude and current clearance.
stages.query: 装球 杯子 夹取 抓杯 姿态 杯口 朝上
branches: Use direct single-arm pouring when current reach and wrist geometry allow it; handover is conditional.

stages.goal: Grasp below the lip with stationary closure and verify that the upright cup follows a small lift.
stages.applicability: The grasp is selected for the full pouring attitude and the cup is supported.
completion: A current small lift and wrist RGB support that the cup follows the hand upright.
Current cup-to-gripper geometry is supported before transit.
stages.query: 合拢 夹爪 抓起 杯子 提起 杯口 朝上
dependencies: Current measured cup and vase geometry; full-pour grasp lookahead.
branches: If grasp fails, reacquire the supported cup before transit.
A changed cup-to-hand transform invalidates the old grasp adaptation; revise only affected assumptions.

stages.goal: Transfer the upright supported grasp to the other arm when current reach or pouring orientation requires it.
stages.applicability: The current holding arm cannot execute the necessary grasp-relative rotation or reach.
completion: The receiving hand visibly carries the cup before the giving hand clears.
The new cup-to-hand transform is verified before pouring.
stages.query: 双手 换手 交接 接杯 松开 原手
dependencies: A verified held cup and a current reason for handover.
branches: Skip this optional stage when direct pouring remains applicable.
Recheck full-pour axis and clearance for the new grasp; do not treat the old wrist attitude as preserved.

stages.goal: Carry upright and place the actual pouring lip just above the measured inner vase opening.
stages.applicability: A verified grasp and current cup-to-hand offset are available.
completion: Current wrist/head evidence supports the low lip above and inside the inner opening with margin.
stages.query: 持杯 移到 花瓶 瓶口 杯口 位置 对齐
dependencies: Verified current grasp; measured inner opening and body clearance.
branches: Stop near the vase for wrist feedback and update invalid measurements.
If required collision clearance moves the outflow point too high/outside, return upright and adjust approach before flow.

stages.goal: Tilt outward along the adapted grasp-relative rotation, keep the actual low rim inside the opening, and hold for ball flow.
stages.applicability: The current lip path, grasp and inner-opening clearance support the full tilt.
completion: Observe flow at onset and final inversion, then inspect remaining/spilled balls.
All-seven-inside remains unknown without sufficient current evidence; an empty cup alone is insufficient.
stages.query: 朝向 花瓶口 倾倒 小球 杯口 下倾 向下 保持
dependencies: Verified grasp-relative motion and supported low-rim alignment.
branches: Pause at onset of flow and adapt small geometry/motion changes within the stage.
On rejected tracking retain the grasp and recover from the fresh measured pose; never repeat deeper tilt from an assumed target.
If the grasp/path is no longer applicable, revise only affected plan assumptions.

stages.goal: Reverse the supported tilt, carry the cup upright to clear table support, and release only after support.
stages.applicability: The cup is still held; pouring has finished or needs safe reversal.
completion: Current evidence supports upright cup and table support before release.
The released cup remains upright; ball transfer remains a separate evidence question.
stages.query: 扶正 杯子 杯口 朝上 恢复 直立 落桌 释放
dependencies: Current grasp and measured safe return/support path.
branches: Use this stage for safe outward-tilt reversal when necessary; its direction is opposite to controlled_pour.

stages.goal: Withdraw clear of the upright released cup and vase, return both arms home, and retain an evidence-based task outcome.
stages.applicability: The cup is supported upright and the fingers are released.
completion: Both arms return to initial poses.
All seven balls, upright cup and home arms are assessed separately; unknown observations are not converted into success.
stages.query: 松开 杯子 撤回 双臂 归位
dependencies: Supported upright cup and released fingers.
branches: If still active, inspect supported unmet requirements without assuming that an empty-looking cup proves success.
